general_notes: Across all four states the candidates fall into five recurring kinds: (1) the target with a plain dark border (idle B, joyful A, fierce E, depleted B), effectively identical; (2) a square soft-vignette app presentation and (3) a round soft-vignette app presentation, both showing the painting slightly scaled, slightly softened and with periphery darkened/cropped (character intact); (4) a heavily blurred version that keeps composition but loses brushwork; (5) a procedural/3D-style render (idle H, joyful E, fierce D, depleted H) that is a clearly different character rendering. Within the vignette groups I could not distinguish individual images by eye except that some round vignettes show a faintly lighter circular rim (joyful D, fierce C, depleted G), which I scored slightly lower on P3. The softening of vignette candidates is judged at the displayed resolution and is uncertain; it may be resampling only. The grey rectangle artifact in the depleted target is preserved in B and C and hidden by the vignettes; I did not penalise its absence on character dimensions.
